items.title: Two ideals with trivial sum can be interpolated by a unit-valued group element with prescribed residues
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file etale-cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma interpolates elements of the group G(R) prescribed modulo two ideals with trivial sum (statement lines 14700-14706). The proof (proof lines 14708-14728) chooses x in I congruent to 1 modulo J, replaces the ideals by xR and (x-1)R, reformulates the problem as the unit condition that 1 + pi s be a unit with two congruence conditions, and applies the monogenic-extension lemma of the same chapter. H2: one reduction plus one application of the extension lemma.
